{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABZY4krg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhDANuM", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 31, "title": "Implement clocked SH-2 multiplier and MACH/MACL pipeline interlocks", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At `ed39a35efd46c4ad1f961071d60476119cda7f0d`, multiplication and accumulation compute results, but their timing lacks retained multiplier state. `src/cpu/timing.rs::execution_states` assigns fixed costs, while `Cpu::execute` adds only the existing load-writeback interlock. Consequently, adjacent multiplier operations and accesses to MACH/MACL cannot incur the documented history-dependent stalls.

This affects general arithmetic kernels and their timing relative to the other CPU, DMA and interrupts. Correct arithmetic results alone do not establish this hardware behavior.

## Expected outcome

Implement CPU-local multiplier availability and the associated instruction interlocks for MULS.W, MULU.W, MUL.L, DMULS.L, DMULU.L, MAC.W, MAC.L, CLRMAC, and register/memory LDS/STS accesses to MACH/MACL. Integrate them with actual emulated clocks, bus replay and independent CPU scheduling.

The primary contract is Hitachi's [SH-1/SH-2 Programming Manual](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/h12p0.pdf): §§7.2–7.3/table 7.2; §7.7.2, SH-2 figures 7.23–7.44 and 7.53–7.73; and §7.7.6, figures 7.88–7.91. These distinguish multiplier operation, access stages and contention. The later [Renesas software manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/mah/sh-1sh-2sh-dsp-software-manual), §7.2.3, explicitly states that multiplier operation advances in cycles independently of slot length. Use SH-2 rules, excluding SH-1 and SH-DSP behavior.

Scope includes multiplier-related access conflicts and their interaction with existing fetch, load-writeback and bus scheduling. General speculative pipeline completion remains separate #17 work. Do not replace sequence-dependent behavior with a constant maximum cost.

## Context and reproduction

Read-only inspection establishes the gap:

- `src/cpu.rs:117–126,369–374,562–599` contains load-pipeline state, fixed timing selection and immediate multiply/MAC calculations, with no retained multiplier occupancy.
- `tests/fixtures/build_sh2_timing.py:16–40` defines seventeen timing kernels, none exercising a multiplication producer.
- `src/cpu/tests.rs:720–741` checks multiply results and flags, without sequence timing.
- `docs/hardware-conformance.md:1781–1784` explicitly leaves multiplier hazards outstanding.

Existing infrastructure is reusable: `Machine::issue_cpu` journals suspended instructions; bus transactions already support scheduled CPU-local pipeline waits; native and production browser tests execute identical original FRT-timed guests on both CPUs.

The latest validation record reports 818 passing native tests and successful browser checks for the previous increment. The supplied current-main CI snapshot is still in progress; it establishes neither failure nor success. No complete suites were rerun during this planning pass. The supplied open-Issue inventory is empty.

If an applicable primary correction contradicts this AI-authored description, update the source Issue with the exact reference, rationale and corrected independent expectations. Such technical correction requires no human confirmation and must preserve the fixed goal.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Publish a primary-derived producer/consumer timing table before using implementation output as evidence. Cover every scoped multiplier family, MACH/MACL transfer class, adjacent operations and progressively separated operations. Identify which cited diagrams include fetch contention.
- [ ] Add independent native instruction-sequence vectors for those classes, including signed/unsigned forms, consecutive MAC sequences, CLRMAC and both MACH/MACL transfer directions. Assert elapsed clocks alongside arithmetic, flags, saturation, register preservation and address updates. Preserve the existing STS-to-GPR writeback hazard checks.
- [ ] Demonstrate both required stalls and documented overlap without stalls. Include multiplier-related IF/MA conflicts where applicable; do not label warmed-cache execution automatically contention-free without a specification-derived explanation.
- [ ] Verify clock progression through intervening instructions and existing external/on-chip waits. Multiplier availability must reflect elapsed SH-2 clocks rather than host step counts, avoid double-counting waits, and remain independent between master and slave. Exercise both supported PLL selections.
- [ ] Add focused scheduler/bus tests around multiplier access boundaries, replay suspension and completion. Check that dependent memory transfers occur at their permitted boundary, completed effects are not repeated, and the peer CPU and DMA continue according to their own deadlines.
- [ ] Verify cold reset, slave stop/start and watchdog reset during affected sequences, plus interrupt/NMI entry and return around them. Assert guest results, saved state and absence of stale work; derive subtle completion/flush rules from affirmative primary evidence.
- [ ] Add an original MIT-licensed synthetic BIOS guest, reproducible source/build artifacts and authored expectations. Both SH-2s must measure adjacent and separated arithmetic kernels with their own FRT and publish computed results through ordinary guest instructions. Run identical bytes natively and in rebuilt production browser Wasm under `/saturn-rust/`, with repeated cold boots.
- [ ] Include operand mutations that change computed results, spacing mutations that change contention, and omitted-operation controls. Record an expected assertion failure against the inherited fixed-cost behavior or an isolated disabled-interlock mutation. Expected values must not call production timing helpers or come from recorded emulator output.
- [ ] Preserve existing tests and demonstrations, including Star Collector, Prism Courier, Hardware Lab, address-error/reset, bus/DMA, sound, controller, backup and privacy checks. Any necessary correction to an existing timing expectation must cite primary evidence and retain its substantive regression coverage.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native and Wasm Clippy with warnings denied, all registered fixture/media reproduction checks, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, and the complete extended `npm run test:browser`, without required skips.
- [ ] Update architecture, conformance and validation records with exact specification references, implementation/test links, observed results and remaining limitations. Keep all unmet #17 requirements explicit. This increment does not establish full pipeline accuracy, complete hardware or commercial-game compatibility.

## Optional validation

Additional generated producer/consumer sequences checked against an independently authored timing model. No personal firmware, commercial media, physical console, human approval or live Pages inspection is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
